propositions: Destructive repair must acquire durable pause ownership via refs/reconciler/gate before mutation, failing closed if git identity is missing or pause already held by another actor.
Repair ownership token is generated as repair:<surface>:<uuid4> and written via CAS; pre-existing pauses abort repair without clearing them.
Lock acquisition must succeed via refs/reconciler/lock in-flight check (HELD, corrupt, timeout, transport/auth failure, or uncertainty all abort) before destructive mutation begins.

Cleanup is fail-closed: reread pause and OID as one snapshot, clear only if reason matches this invocation's token, and pass observed OID to CAS release; missing/replaced/changed pause during cleanup surfaces error without retry or recreation.
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair use the same pause ownership contract without requiring gh binary, preserving existing public vocabulary and non-repair behavior.
Provider-neutral pause behavior must work across local, GHA, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare environments; ownership replacement cannot clear another actor's pause.
